description.value: A large municipal recreation complex in Aldergrove operated by the Township of Langley, featuring indoor pools with waterslides, a wave pool, river channel, spray park, ice arena, fitness centre, indoor walking track, and an outdoor experience area. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley will find it a practical stop with change-room showers, washrooms, and on-site food options including a Triple O's restaurant.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Township of Langley municipal community centre with pools, arena, fitness centre, spray park, and other recreation amenities. Washrooms are explicitly mentioned under the Accessibility section ('washroom on deck and in change rooms'). Showers are evidenced by 'change room with handheld shower head.' Food on site is confirmed via 'food truck' listed as an amenity and 'Triple O's' as a leased tenant. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website. The website calls it 'Aldergrove Community Centre' while OSM includes the sponsor name 'Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre.'
concerns: OSM name includes sponsor branding ('Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre') while the website consistently uses 'Aldergrove Community Centre'
OSM record has no address or phone; values sourced from the website only

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-equipped municipal recreation centre on the Fraser Highway corridor offering washrooms, showers, and food — practical amenities for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley, even though no cycling-specific services are confirmed.
